messages.subject: Error in .jcall
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I am trying some basic operation in RHIPE like rhls, rhread, rhwrite etc.

I tried following commands:

rhls("hdfs://------:8020/user") works fine and listed all the files/directory from HDFS.

rhread("hdfs://----:8020/user/w1.dat") shows following error:

Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod", cl,  :
  java.io.FileNotFoundException: File file:/user/w1.dat does not exist

Another command, i tried:

rhget("hdfs://-------:8020/user/w1.dat", "/root/Desktop/") shows following error:
Copying hdfs://-------:8020/user/w1.dat to /root/Desktop/
Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod", cl,  :
java.net.ConnectException: Call From n1.pal.com/10.0.7.243 <http://n1.pal.com/10.0.7.243> to n1.pal.com:8020 <http://n1.pal.com:8020> failed on connection exception: java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused; For more details see:  http://wiki.apache.org/hadoop/ConnectionRefused

File exists into HDFS, having full privileges and rhls command also shows the file also.
Can anyone please help me regarding this issue.

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhipe with hortonworks hadoop
messages.body_plain:
There shouldn't be a reason why it wont work with HortonWorks, though i wouldn't surprised if some changes would be required.
For example, RHIPE doesn't seem to work with stock apache hadoop because of one API call! This api calls makes it work with CDH clusters. I'm sure there is a simple work around but since I work with CDH clusters (and i think Ryan too), we test against CDH.

If you're a developer, we can assist in fixing bugs.
